subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram coverage with startup behavior

question: Should this stacked Telegram QA PR be retargeted and re-reviewed only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114055 merges?
rationale: The parent refactor owns the runner-side smoke-selection boundary, and the local review environment could not independently inspect the combined final tree.

options.title: Retarget then re-review
options.body: Merge the parent refactor, retarget this PR to main, and rerun focused Telegram plus QA Smoke evidence on the exact new head.

options.title: Review the combined stack
options.body: Approve the child only if a maintainer independently verifies the parent and child together preserve the intended smoke membership.

recommendation.title: Retarget then re-review
recommendation.body: Merge the parent refactor, retarget this PR to main, and rerun focused Telegram plus QA Smoke evidence on the exact new head.
